# Yousef Alaghehband

International Fencing Coach, FIE Master Coach, former National Coach of the Canadian Para Fencing Team and international referee.

Official website: https://www.youseffencing.org/

## Core topics
- School and university fencing programs
- After-school fencing programs
- International fencing camps
- Private fencing coaching
- High-performance athlete development
- Para fencing
- Coach education
- International fencing partnerships

## Profile summary
Yousef Alaghehband has more than 30 years of international coaching experience across five continents. His work spans grassroots and school fencing through national-team and international competition environments.
